body: You've included unrelated code, please remove it

I made a mistake during rebase by amending prior to rebase continue. The Merge pull request 991ceb should not be there and only three files are modified with this PR. Can someone advise on how to correct? Thanks!
You can just do `git reset --soft master` and then make your new commit

> You can just do `git reset --soft master` and then make your new commit

Is the new commit in the form of `git commit --amend` or `git commit -m "[comment]"`?
New commit, you will be back on `master` after this change, you will also need to remove the unrelated changes from the commit directly

> New commit, you will be back on `master` after this change, you will also need to remove the unrelated changes from the commit directly

Thanks. I wonder if there's a way to make git even more always within a keystroke of catastrophe?
It's easy to accidentally `--amend` by accident (which is what happened in this case)

> It's easy to accidentally `--amend` by accident (which is what happened in this case)

It would actually be easier at this point for me to delete this PR and resubmit an identical one. I could do this faster than figuring out how to unstage hundreds of files in the soft reset branch.
You don't have hundreds of files, just 5 to fix, if you need help I can just fix it for you and you can recommit to fix the authorship

Yes, that would be much appreciated. Please let me know exactly how to recommit to fix the authorship. What I see after doing the soft reset is hundreds of modified green staged files, so I'm not sure how to fix it. Thanks for your help
Correction, I didn't realize you weren't synced with `master`, you should instead just do `git reset --soft HEAD~`, see if that works out for you
Still same state after `git reset --soft HEAD~` I did do a rebase on this branch to the master branch that I synched today. Any other ideas?
I'll help, but when I do `git reset --soft HEAD~` it just shows the 8 files
Now you can just do `git commit --amend --reset-author`

That looks good - thanks! Is there a way to unstage everything on my local branch so I am in synch with the PR? Or what about deleting my local branch and cloning the PR?

If I do `git commit --amend --reset-author` with the staged files, will it ignore them?
You just pull it, use `git reset --hard origin/scroll_container_hold_when_max`. Staged files will be added

Okay, now there are no staged files - response was `HEAD is now at 991bceb3fb Merge pull request #105470 from clayjohn/RID-owner-limit`

When I reset the author it returned `[scroll_container_hold_when_max 89b7b1e245] Merge pull request #105470 from clayjohn/RID-owner-limit`. Is it safe to force push now?

No you've done something wrong, do the following:
```
git reset --hard origin/scroll_container_hold_when_max
git commit --amend --reset-author
```
It should say `[ScrollContainer] Add option to hold child at maximum scroll value when resized` for the message

Should I be in my local master branch when I do `git reset --hard origin/scroll_container_hold_when_max`? If I do it while in my local `scroll_container_hold_when_max` branch, it still returns `HEAD is now at 991bceb3fb Merge pull request #105470 from clayjohn/RID-owner-limit`.
No you should be in your local branch of this PR

Looking back at my original mistake, I entered `git commit --amend` before entering `git rebase --continue`, then I dug the hole deeper by not entering `git commit --amend` after doing the continue. I then did the force push, which resulted in the extra files in the PR.

Any suggestions on getting back to go? Sorry for all the trouble.
Just abort the rebase, and then reset, it should just be clean
It says no rebase in progress. Is there another form of reset I can try?
Then you're good, restore the files with `git restore *`
Still tells me `HEAD is now at 991bceb3fb Merge pull request #105470 from clayjohn/RID-owner-limit`. Is there a way to reset the HEAD to the most recent `a46e3bc`?

You are on the PR branch?

Maybe we can discuss this in rocket chat because this is very much flooding this PR

But I can't help any more today, will check tomorrow though
Just messaged you in rocket chat and can continue tomorrow. Thanks!
Recently ran into really wishing this was in the engine, do you think you'll have time to work on this again soon?

> Recently ran into really wishing this was in the engine, do you think you'll have time to work on this again soon?

Needs a rebase closer to current master. Might be a little bit before I can get to it. I'm surprised that I don't see more interest in this enhancement, as it's actually essential for common kinds of desired scroll behavior.
Do you have time now (or within the next few months) since we're fresh out of feature freeze with the new release?
